segments.name: Diagnostics
segments.description: Commercial-stage cancer prevention diagnostics company providing noninvasive esophageal precancer testing for at-risk GERD patients.
segments.evidence: The Company manages the business activities on a consolidated basis and operates in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid primarily by patients and their third-party insurers, plus cash-pay and contracted services arrangements, for EsoGuard laboratory testing services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue is primarily generated by its laboratory testing services utilizing its EsoGuard Esophageal DNA tests.
